requirements.title: Shipment Management
requirements.description: End-to-end management of shipments, including tracking, fulfillment, international customs processing, delivery management, auto-generated commercial invoices, packing slip generation, shipment entity configuration, real-time tracking, and bulk actions.

requirements.title: Security and Compliance Infrastructure
requirements.description: Ensure security and compliance with features such as denied party screening performance, merging all security, encryption, audit, and compliance requirements.

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: Ensure the system's performance, scalability, and uptime meet the required standards, including warehouse barcode scan-to-database-update latency, tracking event ingestion, report generation performance, and high availability.

requirements.title: Carrier Integration and Rate Shopping
requirements.description: Integrate with multiple carriers to compare rates and services, and book shipments.

requirements.title: Warehouse Management
requirements.description: Comprehensive management of warehouse operations, including floor plan, pick-pack-ship, put-away rules, wave picking optimization, and inventory replenishment with automatic reorder point calculation.

requirements.title: Data Management and Analytics
requirements.description: Storage, analysis, and reporting of logistics data, including time-series data, labor productivity, and other key performance indicators.

requirements.title: System Integration
requirements.description: The system must integrate well with external systems, including a dead letter queue for failed carrier API calls, ERP integration health check, and generic EDI for ASN and transportation status synchronization.

requirements.title: Workflow and Exception Handling
requirements.description: Workflows for handling shipment exceptions, including identification, assignment, resolution, and update of shipment status, as well as route optimization to minimize cost, time, or carbon footprint.
